economic_hypothesis: The market may underreact to earnings news. The direction of a fully observed stock-minus-SPY close-to-close reaction following an SEC Item 2.02 filing may predict same-direction residual returns over the next 20 sessions.

event_definition.public_clock: later of exact SEC API acceptance timestamp and 00:00 New York on filingDate
event_definition.reaction_session: first regular XNYS close at least 30 minutes after public_clock
event_definition.reaction_return: issuer close-to-close return minus SPY close-to-close return on reaction_session
event_definition.threshold_clock: only reaction sessions strictly earlier than the current reaction session
event_definition.entry: next regular XNYS open after reaction_session close
event_definition.exit: regular XNYS open 20 sessions after entry
event_definition.position: 50 percent signed issuer and 50 percent opposite-signed SPY per unit gross exposure
event_definition.same_ticker_same_filing_date: keep earliest public_clock then accession ascending
event_definition.same_ticker_overlap: keep earliest entry and suppress later signals until prior exit

formal_tests.primary: equal-entry-date mean signed pair return net of 30 bps one-way
formal_tests.stress: equal-entry-date mean signed pair return net of 50 bps one-way
formal_tests.inference: Newey-West on entry-date portfolios with lag 3
formal_tests.multiplicity: Bonferroni using at least the disclosed global trial floor

hard_claim_limits: Item 2.02 identifies an SEC-filed results disclosure but may lag the issuer or newswire first-public earnings release.
SEC API acceptance timestamps are not reconciled to raw accession SGML headers.
The universe is selected from 2026 survivors and lacks permanent security identities and delisting returns.
Yahoo closes and adjusted opens are retrospective proxies and not executable quotes.
Historical borrow, financing and TAQ impact are absent.
The 2025 cohort must remain signal-clock-only and may not join any price value.
